### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **15** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/seed.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**10** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_

- `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`  _(via SeedSchema (symbol, a top-level const), crm_rating_band (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedSchema), dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_

- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via dependsOn (literal, a string literal in a comment in SeedLoaderService; a string literal in refuseDeclaredDependencies))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/seed.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 50 pages)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **186** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1b5a94f925950e2c05fe5e86a36cc0aefce603de` — the merge of head `a739167a9cb117c30c597b6d282ff7530abb47c7` into base `c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1b5a94f925950e2c05fe5e86a36cc0aefce603de && git checkout 1b5a94f925950e2c05fe5e86a36cc0aefce603de
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58 a739167a9cb117c30c597b6d282ff7530abb47c7 && git checkout -B drift-repro c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58 && git merge --no-ff a739167a9cb117c30c597b6d282ff7530abb47c7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c934631723b7f8d2d447a73d5e7c3428a08cfb58` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

It adds a new authorable spec key `Seed.dependsOn` (object names), with minor bumps on `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. It follows maintainer ruling 「新增 dependsOn 显式声明」 on #33812. The L2 contract review is owed for the new spec key. `check-governed-merges` reads it NOT governed, +838/-17 over 16 files.
- os-dev report 6906493106. Area ruling 6906526976 on #33812 rules both open questions A: a draft publish judges against the same load, and the runtime proof is named in the ledger note with no `proof` field. CI at head: 58 success / 10 skipped / 0 failure. `df0d9422` merges `origin/main` cleanly into `4575480d` (K=15), and the three-dot patch-id `56cda789` is unchanged. The one red on `4575480d` was the `AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052` UI flake that #34231 fixed on main.
- Points for the reviewer:
  - A declared name becomes an edge in the graph the lookup fields already feed. With nothing declared, the old order holds byte for byte. Objects left behind a lookup cycle are appended in an order that keeps the declared edges.
  - A load is refused, with nothing written, when a name is the dataset's own object, when no dataset in the same load seeds it (the message names an env or locale scope-out), or when a declared edge closes a cycle. A cycle of lookup edges alone still takes deferred passes.

  - The `ISeedLoaderService` contract signature is unchanged; `buildDependencyGraph` gains an optional declared map.

- Out of scope: `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` still teaches array order. That is #34277, for after this PR lands.

## Review — PASS

Head-sha: `df0d942291d66f51a7613f5451d2b5ed52259b94`
Area: S2 / A4 · Fixes #33812 · L1, the ordinary ACCEPT read per review-checklist.md. The new authorable key `Seed.dependsOn` (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`) owes L2 its CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER record. This PASS does not stand in for it.

1. **Ruling followed.** The maintainer ruled 「新增 dependsOn 显式声明」 on #33812, and area ruling 6906526976 settled both open questions as A. A draft publish is its own load, and the runtime proof is named in the ledger note with no `proof` field. The changeset and `seed-data.mdx` both say so.
2. **The mechanism, read on the tree (`seed-loader.ts`).**
   - `collectDeclaredDependencies` pools each object's declarations across its datasets and judges only the datasets this load seeds. It keeps "scoped out by env/locale" apart from "no dataset seeds it", using `request.seeds` minus the loaded set.
   - The declared edges join the same node's `dependsOn` after the field edges, deduplicated, so `topologicalSort` uses them through its existing adjacency. With nothing declared, `declared` is empty and `orderByDeclaredEdges` returns its input unchanged, so the order is the old one byte for byte. The no-`dependsOn` CONTROL pins this.
   - The leftover append after a lookup cycle is a stable reorder that keeps declared edges, and it cannot drop an object (`next === -1` takes the first).
   - `findDeclaredEdgeCycles` refuses `A → B` when a BFS finds `B ⇝ A` over the combined graph with self-edges excluded, which means the edge lies on a cycle. A cycle made only of lookup edges is not judged, and its CONTROL stays on deferred passes.
3. **The refusal returns rather than throws, and that is the right call.**
   - The refusal comes before any write. `buildResult` with `errors.length > 0` answers `success: false`, `results: []`.
   - All three `AppPlugin` call sites read `result.errors` from a returned result. A throw would have taken the basic-insert fallback the body names, so returning is what keeps rows from being written in authored order.
   - The error is `ReferenceResolutionError` with `field: 'dependsOn'`, `targetField: '(dataset)'` and `recordIndex: 0`. That is the schema's closed shape. Widening it is out of scope, and the Acceptance notes say so.
4. **Spec.** `dependsOn` is `z.array(z.string().regex(<object machine name>)).optional()` on the `strictObject`, with no default, so an author who omits it changes nothing. `defineSeed` refuses the dataset's own object at call time. `ISeedLoaderService` is unchanged, and `buildDependencyGraph` takes the declared map as an optional second argument. The other callers (purge, sample-data scope) are untouched and still correct, because they delete rows and the key only matters for insert-time reads.
5. **Tests.**
   - The loader file covers the card's shape: the fake engine stamps the band count at insert time, and the rating sees 2. It also covers pooled declarations, a dataset downstream of a lookup cycle, the refusals (a cycle closed through a lookup, a cycle of declared edges only, own object, unknown name, env-scoped-out name), a scoped-out dataset that is not judged, and the dry run.
   - On the base blob the file runs 9 red / 3 green, and the 3 green are exactly the controls.
   - The dogfood proof is a real stack boot with a sandboxed `beforeInsert` hook, read back over REST: 2 bands with `dependsOn`, 0 without. Its `dist/` ablation turns it red.
   - The own-object guard's ablation stays green because a one-object cycle already refuses that case. The body records this, and the guard stays for its clearer message. Agreed.
6. **Declarations.**
   - `Fixes #33812` is the one closing declaration.
   - The changeset levels are `spec` minor and `metadata-protocol` minor. That is "at least minor" for `added`, and the over-level on metadata-protocol is allowed.
   - `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` names the stale `seeds.md` teaching, carried by #34277, which runs after this PR lands. For a widening that is acceptable.
   - There is no `!` and no narrowing arm, so no dogfood battery is owed. `Dogfood Regression Gate` is success.
   - The off-surface files are required by gates and each is named: `engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (3 rows) and the regenerated reference pages.
7. **Nit, non-blocking.** The spec pins are in a new card-named file, `packages/spec/src/data/seed-depends-on-33812.test.ts`, while `seed.test.ts` already holds `SeedSchema`'s cases. AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846) asks for a new top-level `describe` there when the component has a shared harness file. `seed.test.ts` is a plain schema-test file with no harness, so I read this as within the rule's letter. A move is optional.
8. **Merge and checks.** `df0d9422` is a clean merge of main into `4575480d`. The own-diff patch-id is `56cda7895e` on both, so the merge brought only main's changes. Check-runs on the head: 58 success, 10 skipped, none failed or pending. `mergeable_state` is clean, and `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `31eb2aeda2` is clean.

The patch-id is `56cda7895ea5c4fc3a1182b804b47cd69d931973`. A clean main merge that keeps it keeps this PASS.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `df0d942291d66f51a7613f5451d2b5ed52259b94`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/seed-depends-on-33812.test.ts, packages/spec/liveness/seed.json, packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/seed.md, packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-depends-on-33812.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/seed-depends-on-33812.dogfood.test.ts, scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json + packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts, docs/adr/0054-runtime-proof-for-authorable-surface.md

Read at 2026-11-16T05:11Z. First review of this head; claim: comment 6907827915; no lane request (owed per check-owed-reviews). Independence: implemented in a project thread for domain:server#5 (zhuangjianguo); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

This is the first contract review of this PR, so no earlier contract finding is continued. The lane review 6907406090 is a separate record; its item 7 (the card-named spec test file) is the lane's and is not carried here.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The key and its describe.** `Seed.dependsOn` is `z.array(z.string().regex(...)).optional()` on the strict seed object, with no default. The item pattern is the one `Seed.object` uses, so every name an author can seed can be named. The describe says what the key is for, that each name is an edge in the load's graph, the three refusals and what an omitted key means. It agrees with the loader on each point. The regenerated reference rows (`seed`, `seed-loader`, `package-api` twice, `manifest`) carry that describe word for word, and `authorable-surface/data.json` gains `data/Seed:dependsOn`.
- **Ruling 6902020933, point by point.**
  - Names objects, edges join the lookup graph: `collectDeclaredDependencies` pools names per object and `buildDependencyGraph` appends them to the node's `dependsOn`, which `topologicalSort` already reads. Held.
  - A declared edge that closes a cycle refuses the load: `findDeclaredEdgeCycles` refuses an edge whose target reaches its declarer over the combined graph. A cycle of lookup edges alone is not judged. Held.
  - A name not seeded in the same load refuses the load: judged against the datasets left after the env and locale filter. Held.
  - No `dependsOn` keeps today's order exactly: with nothing declared the edge map is empty, no node changes, and `orderByDeclaredEdges` returns its input. The control test pins the old order. Held.
  - Liveness entry and runtime proof: the `dependsOn` row is `live`, its evidence names the three loader symbols that exist at this head, and `dataset.dependsOn` is read in one place. The dogfood file boots a real stack and reads 2 against a control of 0. Held.
- **Ruling 6906526976.** Point 1 (a draft publish is its own load): built as ruled. Point 2 (no `proof` field, proof named in the note): agrees with ADR-0054 section 1, which asks a `proof` only for its high-risk classes and regression fixes.
- **Nothing is written before a refusal.** The refusal returns ahead of the first dataset. The one step before it, opening the landed-key record, reads a definition and writes nothing.
- **The declared order survives a lookup cycle.** A declarer whose target sits behind a lookup cycle is left over with it, and the leftover append keeps every declared edge. Row inserts are never deferred to pass 2, only reference updates, so a target's rows are present when the declarer is written.
- **The key reaches the loader on each of the six request builders.** Each passes the dataset through whole. No builder picks keys.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` minor and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor. `Metadata-protocol: added` asks at least minor on each published package the diff moves, and both are moved. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right: one optional key, no default, no existing value refused. Both declaration lines stand in the PR body and in the changeset body. The private dogfood package needs no changeset. `ISeedLoaderService.buildDependencyGraph` keeps its signature; the class method gains an optional second argument.

CI at this head: 68 check-runs, 58 success, 10 skipped, none failed, none pending. The PR is still a draft; `mergeable_state` reads clean.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Three paths sit outside the claimed file surface and each is named in the report: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (3 rows for the new test double), the dogfood proof file, and the regenerated `package-api` and `manifest` reference pages.
- `packages/runtime` and `packages/cli` are not in the diff. S1 below is about a claim the diff makes about them.
- No governed path. No security finding at the rule layer: the key changes the order of writes the load already makes, and no permission, sharing or credential rule is read or changed by it.
- The refusal's unit is the load, as ruled. Where one load carries the datasets of several apps or packages, a refused declaration refuses all of them. That is the ruling applied, and it is noted so the seat reads it knowingly.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` against ruling 6902020933 and its first consumer, `SeedLoaderService`: the schema holds. The key, its describe, the `defineSeed` own-object refusal and the loader agree, and the card's shape (a rating scored from bands no lookup orders it after) passes end to end in the dogfood proof.

`packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts`: the `ObjectDependencyNode` comment now says declared edges are in `dependsOn`. True at this head. The purge and sample-data callers build the graph without declared edges, which the report names and which is right for a delete order.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` against the contract it implements: the ordering and the three refusals agree with it. One claim about its callers does not hold.

S1 (should-fix) — A refused load is not reported as a failed load on the boot seed's summary. The PR body says the refusal is returned so that every caller reports it the way it reports any failed load. A refusal answers `success: false` with `errors[]` filled, no result and every row counter at zero. The single-tenant boot seed in `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` records its outcome from the counters alone (`rejected: totalErrored`). So a boot whose whole seed was refused records a source with no rows and no problem. `seedSummaryLine` in `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` drops such a source from the banner's `Seeds:` row, and `composeSeedSettledMessage` in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` answers `ok: true`. The refusal is still logged at `warn`, message by message, so it is not silent. But the two channels built to say that a seed lost rows read clean on a boot that seeded nothing, and that boot is the path the card's fresh-install case runs on. The other five builders carry `errors` or `success` to their caller and do report it. Either make the boot outcome count a refused load as a problem, or narrow the claim and say on the card who carries the gap. No test pins what the boot path reports for a refused load.

N1 (nit) — The docs page and the PR body name one partial load, a seed published on its own. Two more loads carry a subset and refuse the same way: the dev hot-reload seeder loads only the datasets of objects first seen in that reload, so a new object's seed that names an already-seeded object is refused until the next restart, and the refusal text suggests a misspelling. A marketplace install loads one package's datasets. Both follow ruling 6906526976 point 1 as written. A sentence in `seed-data.mdx` would save the author the search.

N2 (nit) — The `Skills-docs:` line in the PR body and the changeset still reads `follow-up owed` with the file path. The card names the follow-up as #34277; the line should carry that number.

Read and not raised: the boot seed's two basic-insert branches (no metadata service; a thrown load) write rows in authored order and honour no ordering edge, lookup or declared. That predates this diff and is unchanged by it.
